theorem matrix_strain (p a : ℝ) :
    strain (matrix p a)=Matrix.diagonal ![-p,1,p-1]

theorem self_similar_profile (p a : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1)) :
    flow (matrix p a)=matrix p a

theorem trace_square (p a : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1)) :
    Matrix.trace (matrix p a*matrix p a)=6

theorem scaled_vorticity (p a c : ℝ) :
    vorticity (c • matrix p a)=![0,2*c*a,0]

theorem scaled_alignment (p a c : ℝ) :
    (strain (c • matrix p a)).mulVec (vorticity (c • matrix p a))=
      c • vorticity (c • matrix p a)

theorem family_component_ode (p a t : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1))
    (ht : t ≠ 1) (i j : Fin 3) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => family p a s i j) (flow (family p a t) i j) t

theorem family_stretching_unbounded (p a : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < 1 ∧ M < stretching (family p a t)

theorem strainSquared_scaled (p a c : ℝ) :
    strainSquared (c • matrix p a)=c^2*(p^2+1+(p-1)^2)

theorem shifted_determinant (p a r : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1)) :
    (r • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)-matrix p a).det=(r-1)^2*(r+2)

theorem profile_polynomial (p a : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1)) :
    matrix p a*matrix p a+matrix p a=(2 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)

theorem nonnormal (p a : ℝ) (hp : 2 < p) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (matrix p a).transpose*matrix p a ≠ matrix p a*(matrix p a).transpose

theorem normalized_scaled (p a c : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : 0 < c) :
    normalizedStretching (c • matrix p a)=1/Real.sqrt (strainFactor p)

theorem exists_profile (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ p a : ℝ, 2 < p ∧ 0 < a ∧ a^2=(p-2)*(p+1) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < normalizedStretching (c • matrix p a) ∧
        normalizedStretching (c • matrix p a) < ε) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 1 → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        HasDerivAt (fun s => family p a s i j) (flow (family p a t) i j) t) ∧
      (∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ t < 1 ∧ M < stretching (family p a t)) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, (r • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)-matrix p a).det=(r-1)^2*(r+2))

theorem no_positive_normalized_threshold :
    ¬ ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ p a : ℝ,
      2 < p → 0 < a → a^2=(p-2)*(p+1) → ε ≤ normalizedStretching (matrix p a)

theorem velocity_fderiv (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    fderiv ℝ (velocity p a t) x=scale t • spatialMap p a
theorem velocity_laplacian (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) : laplacian (velocity p a t) x=0
theorem velocity_divergence (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) : divergence (velocity p a t) x=0

theorem pressure_hessian (t : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    pressureHessian t x=(-2*(scale t)^2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)

theorem momentum (p a t ν : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1)) (ht : t ≠ 1) (x : Space) :
    deriv (fun s => velocity p a s x) t+advection (velocity p a t) x+pressureGradient t x=
      ν • laplacian (velocity p a t) x

theorem pressure_poisson (p a t : ℝ) (ha : a^2=(p-2)*(p+1)) (x : Space) :
    -Matrix.trace (pressureHessian t x)=Matrix.trace (family p a t*family p a t)

theorem velocity_not_periodic (p a t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 1) :
    ¬ ∀ x : Space, velocity p a t (x+Pi.single 1 1)=velocity p a t x

theorem velocity_spatially_unbounded (p a t B : ℝ) (ht : t < 1) :
    ∃ x : Space, B < velocity p a t x 1
theorem density_formula (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) : density p a t x=4*a^2*(scale t)^3

theorem amplification_formula (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    amplification p a t x=4*a^2*(scale t)^4

theorem pressure_formula (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    pressureContraction p a t x=-8*a^2*(scale t)^4

theorem minus_pressure_balance (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) (ht : t ≠ 1) :
    deriv (fun s => density p a s x) t+fderiv ℝ (density p a t) x (velocity p a t x)=
      amplification p a t x-pressureContraction p a t x

theorem plus_pressure_fails (p a t : ℝ) (x : Space) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ht : t < 1) :
    deriv (fun s => density p a s x) t+fderiv ℝ (density p a t) x (velocity p a t x) ≠
      amplification p a t x+pressureContraction p a t x

theorem vorticity_trace_identity (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    dotProduct (vorticity A) (vorticity A)+Matrix.trace (A*A)=frobeniusSquared A

theorem source_trace_under_poisson (A P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hP : -Matrix.trace P=Matrix.trace (A*A)) :
    Matrix.trace (sourceStrainRHS A P)=frobeniusSquared A

theorem no_traceless_repair (A P D : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0)
    (hP : -Matrix.trace P=Matrix.trace (A*A)) (hD : Matrix.trace D=0) :
    Matrix.trace (sourceStrainRHS A P+D) ≠ 0

theorem full_trace_zero_iff_poisson (A P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace (fullStrainRHS A P)=0 ↔ -Matrix.trace P=Matrix.trace (A*A)

theorem traceFree_trace_zero_iff (A P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace (traceFreeStrainRHS A P)=0 ↔ Matrix.trace P=0

theorem momentum (nu t : ℝ) (x : Space) (i : Fin 3) :
    deriv (fun s => velocity nu s x i) t+realAdvection (velocity nu t) x i+
      realPartial i (pressure nu t) x=
      nu*realLaplacian (fun y => velocity nu t y i) x
theorem incompressible (nu t : ℝ) (x : Space) : realDivergence (velocity nu t) x=0

theorem periodic (nu t : ℝ) (x : Space) (i j : Fin 3) :
    Function.Periodic (fun r => velocity nu t (Function.update x j r) i) (2*Real.pi)
theorem abc_amplification_mean : realBoxAverage (realAmplification (realizeReal abc))=3/2

theorem abc_pressure_mean : realBoxAverage (realPressureContraction (realizeReal abc)
    (realSynthesis (-kinetic (𝕜

theorem flow_stretching_mean_derivative (nu t : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s => realBoxAverage (realStretching (velocity nu s))) t=0
theorem abc_viscous_mean : realBoxAverage (realViscous (realizeReal abc))=0
theorem profile_smooth (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun x : Space => realizeReal abc x i)

theorem pressure_formula (nu t : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    pressure nu t x= -(1/2 : ℝ)*∑ i, (velocity nu t x i)^2

theorem pressure_periodic (nu t : ℝ) (x : Space) (j : Fin 3) :
    Function.Periodic (fun r => pressure nu t (Function.update x j r)) (2*Real.pi)
theorem plusPressureRHS_initial (nu : ℝ) : plusPressureRHS nu 0=3

theorem plus_pressure_balance_fails (nu : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun s => realBoxAverage (realStretching (velocity nu s))) 0≠plusPressureRHS nu 0

theorem minus_pressure_initial (nu : ℝ) :
    realBoxAverage (realAmplification (velocity nu 0))-
      realBoxAverage (realPressureContraction (velocity nu 0) (pressure nu 0))-
        2*nu*realBoxAverage (realViscous (velocity nu 0))=0
theorem bound_summable (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) : Summable (bound k s)

theorem jet_derivative (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (jet k s) (jet (k+1) s y) y
theorem jet_smooth (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (jet k s)
theorem jet_periodic (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : Function.Periodic (jet k s) (2*Real.pi)

theorem parameter_derivative (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u => jet k u y) (jet (k+2) s y) s

theorem heat_equation (nu t y : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    deriv (fun u => profile nu u y) t = nu*deriv (deriv (profile nu t)) y
theorem positive_parameter (nu t : ℝ) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 0 < 1+nu*t

theorem profile_joint_continuous (nu t y : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => profile nu p.1 p.2) (t,y)

theorem scalar_laplacian (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (x : Space) :
    realLaplacian (scalar nu t) x =
      2*jet 2 (1+nu*t) (x 1)-amplitude nu t*Real.sin (x 2)

theorem scalar_time_derivative (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (x : Space) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u => scalar nu u x)
      (nu*(2*jet 2 (1+nu*t) (x 1)-amplitude nu t*Real.sin (x 2))) t

theorem advection_zero (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (x : Space) (i : Fin 3) :
    realAdvection (velocity nu t) x i = 0

theorem incompressible (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (x : Space) :
    realDivergence (velocity nu t) x = 0

theorem momentum (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (x : Space) (i : Fin 3) :
    deriv (fun u => velocity nu u x i) t+realAdvection (velocity nu t) x i+
      realPartial i (fun _ : Space => (0 : ℝ)) x =
        nu*realLaplacian (fun y => velocity nu t y i) x
theorem spatial_smooth (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (velocity nu t)

theorem periodic (nu t : ℝ) (x : Space) (j : Fin 3) :
    Function.Periodic (fun r => velocity nu t (Function.update x j r)) (2*Real.pi)

theorem initial (nu : ℝ) (x : Space) :
    velocity nu 0 x = ![2*jet 0 1 (x 1)+Real.sin (x 2), 0, 0]
theorem initial_smooth (nu : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (velocity nu 0)

theorem solution_nonnegative (nu t : ℝ) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (velocity nu t) ∧
      (∀ x, realDivergence (velocity nu t) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x i, deriv (fun u => velocity nu u x i) t+realAdvection (velocity nu t) x i+
        realPartial i (fun _ : Space => (0 : ℝ)) x =
          nu*realLaplacian (fun y => velocity nu t y i) x)
theorem kernel_real (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (y : ℝ) : kernel s y = (jet 0 s y : ℂ)

theorem coefficient_jet (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (m : ℤ) :
    coefficient (fun y => (jet 0 s y : ℂ)) m = (weight s m : ℂ)

theorem nonzero_tail (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, (N : ℤ) < m ∧ coefficient (fun y => (jet 0 s y : ℂ)) m ≠ 0

theorem full_coefficient_axis (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) (axis m) =
      2*(weight (1+nu*t) m : ℂ)

theorem nonzero_tail_nonnegative (nu t : ℝ) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, (N : ℤ) < m ∧
      fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) (axis m) ≠ 0

theorem initial_tail (nu : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, (N : ℤ) < m ∧
      fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu 0 x 0 : ℂ)) (axis m) ≠ 0

theorem enstrophy_axis_summable (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    Summable (fun m : ℤ => |(m : ℝ)|^2*
      Complex.normSq (fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) (axis m)))

theorem dissipation_axis_summable (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    Summable (fun m : ℤ => |(m : ℝ)|^4*
      Complex.normSq (fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) (axis m)))

theorem coefficient_formula (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (k : Wave) :
    fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) k = spectrumFormula nu t k

theorem coefficient_nonzero_iff (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (k : Wave) :
    fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) k ≠ 0 ↔
      (k 0 = 0 ∧ k 2 = 0) ∨
      (k 0 = 0 ∧ k 1 = 0 ∧ (k 2 = 1 ∨ k 2 = -1))

theorem sector_zero_summable (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    Summable (masked 0 p nu t)

theorem sector_zero_exact (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    moment 0 p nu t = 4*∑' m : ℤ, bound (2*p) (2*(1+nu*t)) m

theorem sector_one_summable (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    Summable (masked 1 p nu t)

theorem sector_one_exact (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    moment 1 p nu t = (amplitude nu t)^2/2

theorem density_summable (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    Summable (density p nu t)

theorem total_moment_exact (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    (∑' k : Wave, density p nu t k) = moment 0 p nu t+moment 1 p nu t

theorem first_sector_lower (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    8*Real.exp (-2*(1+nu*t)) ≤ moment 0 p nu t

theorem low_factor (nu t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-2*(1+nu*t)) = Real.exp (-2)*(amplitude nu t)^2
theorem low_gap_constant : (1 : ℝ) < 16*Real.exp (-2)

theorem enstrophy_order (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    moment 1 1 nu t < moment 0 1 nu t

theorem dissipation_order (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    moment 0 1 nu t < moment 0 2 nu t

theorem binaryRatio_eq (a b d : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (had : a < d) :
    binaryRatio a b d b = (a+b)*(d-b)/((d+b)*(a-b))

theorem binaryRatio_gt_one (a b d : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (had : a < d) :
    1 < binaryRatio a b d b

theorem sourceExpression_eq (a b d e : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    sourceExpression a b d e = binaryRatio a b d e

theorem sourceCentroid_eq (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    sourceCentroid nu t = centroid nu t

theorem sourceCentroid_gt_one (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    1 < sourceCentroid nu t
theorem angular_antipodal (k : Wave) : angularSector (-k) = angularSector k

theorem angular_scale (q : ℤ) (hq : 0 < q) (k : Wave) :
    angularSector (fun i => q*k i) = angularSector k

theorem label_on_spectrum (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (k : Wave)
    (hc : fourierCoefficient (fun x => (velocity nu t x 0 : ℂ)) k ≠ 0) :
    angularSector k = sector k

theorem masked_transfer (j : Fin 2) (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) (k : Wave) :
    angularMasked j p nu t k = masked j p nu t k

theorem moment_transfer (j : Fin 2) (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    angularMoment j p nu t = moment j p nu t

theorem angular_summable (j : Fin 2) (p : ℕ) (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    Summable (angularMasked j p nu t)

theorem angularCentroid_eq (nu t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < 1+nu*t) :
    angularCentroid nu t = sourceCentroid nu t

theorem angularCentroid_gt_one (nu t : ℝ) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    1 < angularCentroid nu t

theorem no_initial_interval_below_one (nu : ℝ) (hnu : 0 ≤ nu) :
    ¬ ∃ T : ℝ, 0 < T ∧ ∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ T → angularCentroid nu t < 1

human_reorganization: The same exact profile polynomial supplies the restricted-Euler ODE and actual affine momentum calculation. These are different mathematical assertions with different spatial hypotheses.

Infinite affine whole-space energy is proved directly from u_2=c*x_2 and expanding boxes; mapped formal sources explicitly prove nonperiodicity and spatial unboundedness, not a named infinite-integral theorem.
The scaled characteristic polynomial is an elementary consequence of the mapped unscaled determinant and positive scaling, not a new named formal theorem.
Equality between the full and deviatoric strain expressions is a direct classical substitution of the mapped pressure Poisson constraint; the formal trace criteria remain distinct.
The periodic viscous mean is reconstructed by three explicit trigonometric products, replacing the mapped invariant-trace transport/cancellation proof.
No proposed general minus-pressure balance is inferred from the two calibration examples. The only refuted formula is written explicitly.

The uniform Gaussian derivative bounds, heat-driven shear and complete normalized integral Fourier series are reconstructed directly. The actual angular partition agrees with the simpler source support labels only on nonzero coefficients, as proved by source transfer. The ratio uses the printed normalization; it is not a claim about every angular tessellation or alternative centroid. Positivity is established on complete infinite moments, with no truncation argument. The heat-governed shear mechanism is classical; finite torus energy is a direct smooth compact-domain consequence.

The prioritized score classifier and relevant boundary are reconstructed exactly. Uniform stability quantifies over all measurable real score perturbations, not merely physically realizable diagnostic trajectories. The stronger sufficient a.e. convergence statement needs the second score only on the active first-score region.

The simultaneous downward shift detects exact boundary mass. The proof of occupation necessity additionally uses monotone labels and the two endpoint indicators, so cancellation of arbitrary exchanges is not ignored.

Finite maximum concentration is distinguished from the earlier squared-weight centroid statistic. Kinks, denominator-controlled Lipschitz bounds and the strictly dominant three-sector constant-time counterexample are proved for their actual scalar functions; no PDE realization is inferred.

The strip-mass power rate is an explicit elementary consequence conditional on actual strip bounds. Audibert–Tsybakov margin context excludes equality and measures excess risk, so it is not imported as an unweighted occupation theorem.
